SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM rn, inner_member.* FROM ( SELECT MBR.MBR_CD, MBR.MBR_ID, MBR.MBR_PW, MBR.MBR_NM, MBR.MBR_NNM, MBR.MBR_TELNO, MBR.MBR_EML_ADDR, MBR.MBR_BASIC_ADDR, MBR.MBR_DETAIL_ADDR, MBR.MBR_PROFIL_IMAGE, TO_CHAR(MBR.MBR_FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS MBR_FRST_REG_DT, MBR.MBR_STATUS_CODE, MBR.MBR_DELETE_DATE, MBR.MBR_ZIP FROM MEMBER MBR
AND MBR.MBR_ID LIKE '%' || #{detailSearch.mbrId} || '%'
AND MBR.MBR_NM LIKE '%' || #{detailSearch.mbrNm} || '%'
AND MBR.MBR_NNM LIKE '%' || #{detailSearch.mbrNnm} || '%'
AND MBR.MBR_FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{detailSearch.mbrFrstRegDtFromString}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND MBR.MBR_FRST_REG_DT < TO_DATE(#{detailSearch.mbrFrstRegDtToPlusOneString}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND MBR.MBR_STATUS_CODE = #{detailSearch.mbrStatusCode}
AND MBR.MBR_EML_ADDR LIKE '%' || #{detailSearch.mbrEmlAddr} || '%'
AND MBR.MBR_CD IN ( SELECT RA_SUB.MBR_CD FROM ROLE_ACHIEVED RA_SUB WHERE RA_SUB.USER_ROLE_ID = #{detailSearch.userRoleId} )
ORDER BY MBR.MBR_FRST_REG_DT DESC ) inner_member WHERE ROWNUM <= #{lastRecordIndex} ) WHERE rn >= #{firstRecordIndex}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEMBER MBR
AND MBR.MBR_ID LIKE '%' || #{detailSearch.mbrId} || '%'
AND MBR.MBR_NM LIKE '%' || #{detailSearch.mbrNm} || '%'
AND MBR.MBR_NNM LIKE '%' || #{detailSearch.mbrNnm} || '%'
AND MBR.MBR_FRST_REG_DT >= TO_DATE(#{detailSearch.mbrFrstRegDtFromString}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND MBR.MBR_FRST_REG_DT < TO_DATE(#{detailSearch.mbrFrstRegDtToPlusOneString}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND MBR.MBR_STATUS_CODE = #{detailSearch.mbrStatusCode}
AND MBR.MBR_EML_ADDR LIKE '%' || #{detailSearch.mbrEmlAddr} || '%'
AND MBR.MBR_CD IN ( SELECT RA_SUB.MBR_CD FROM ROLE_ACHIEVED RA_SUB WHERE RA_SUB.USER_ROLE_ID = #{detailSearch.userRoleId} )

SELECT m.MBR_CD, m.MBR_ID, m.MBR_PW, m.MBR_NM, m.MBR_NNM, m.MBR_TELNO, m.MBR_EML_ADDR, m.MBR_BASIC_ADDR, m.MBR_DETAIL_ADDR, m.MBR_PROFIL_IMAGE, TO_CHAR(m.MBR_FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS MBR_FRST_REG_DT, m.MBR_STATUS_CODE, m.MBR_DELETE_DATE, m.MBR_ZIP, ra.USER_ROLE_ID AS RA_USER_ROLE_ID, ra.MBR_CD AS RA_MBR_CD FROM MEMBER m LEFT JOIN ROLE_ACHIEVED ra ON m.MBR_CD = ra.MBR_CD WHERE m.MBR_CD = #{mbrCd}
